correctness.rationale: Inspected the exact total-cut definition as complements of independent triples, n>=3 and reduced degree 2n−6. Previously published nonequivariant homotopy theorem gives a wedge of B_n even-dimensional spheres, permitting reduced Hopf trace. For each involution g, fixed oriented simplex contributes (-1)^{o_g(σ)+1}, complement produces trace (-1)^{m_g}Σ_{gT=T,α(T)≤2}(-1)^{o_g(T)}. Bipartiteness restricts bad T to size <=4. Recomputed bad triple count 6n²−16n+12 and perfect-matching four-set count (9n²−29n+24)/2; determined S, R, SR fixed orbit counts by even/odd n. The resulting traces equal desired C2×C2 permutation-character twist; rational one-dimensional irreducibles make character equality imply abstract isomorphism. Independent fresh enumerator built graph-edge test and all invariant bad subsets, reproducing all four traces for every n=3..25; finite enumeration only corroborates general orbit proof.
